name: C&S Paper Co.,Ltd
summary: C&S Paper Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells household paper products in Mainland China. The company offers paper rolls, tissue boxes, facial tissues, scented paper handkerchiefs, wipes, non-woven products, personal care products, baby diapers, cotton tissues, etc. It also sells medical devices, disposable medical and hygiene products, disinfectants, kitchenware, sanitary ware, daily sundries, non-woven fabrics and products, wood pulp, auxiliary materials, packaging materials, and baby products, as well as provides warehousing services.
